scope: Same 46 preselected situations, original app prompt, preserved base/adapter, no training. Compare preserved-error history, repaired history, and no history. History fixture is synthetic evaluation-only, not approved training data.
input_source: text-paths-20261114/inputs.local.json; same original-base user histories for every model
repair_policy: Keep system/current question and every historical user message/order unchanged. Replace assistant messages only with fixed reviewed canonical replies below. This is a bundle of factual/register/relevance wording repairs, not an isolated pronoun intervention. No future question or new user fact is injected.
no_history_policy: Retain only the exact existing system and current user message. Do not claim missing-context clarification is retrieved memory or punish absence of unavailable facts as failed recall.
shared: Same NF4 double quant/BF16 compute, official template, constrained XGrammar, unchanged llm_runtime loader/infer, CUDA GPU/eager, seed42 greedy thinking=false max384/context2048 stop248044/248046; no truncation/offload/download/update.
equivalence_policy: Generate a fresh preserved baseline for every model/situation. Within the same model/situation, reuse only if complete conditioned token IDs are identical; record aliases, never call them independent new inference. Different situations are not deduplicated.

review.no_history_memory: conv43/49 have facts in current user message. conv44/46/50 lack required past facts: assess acknowledging absent context rather than guessing. conv45 shortness and summary:conv30 without antecedent are not memory tests; mark memory NA and do not require lost library facts.
review.owner_confusion_tags: Only preserved/repaired fixed conv44/45/46, six situations per model: explicit reversal of user cat ownership. No-history ownership claims belong to invented_missing_context, not a source contradiction.
review.off_topic_carryover_tags: fixed conv47/48/49/50, eight per condition/model: manually identify irrelevant prior-topic/cat repetition; not regex detection.
review.missing_context_tags: no_history fixed conv44/46/50, six per model: one of grounded_missing_context, invented_missing_context, other_or_unassessable. Grounded means acknowledges absent evidence/asks for needed context; generic unrelated answer is not a success.
review.endpoints: Paired preserved/repaired item transitions and affected-history subset (22), 24 empty-history controls separately. No-history information availability differs; no ranking by recall totals across different tasks. Distinguish all-situation common-three-dimension pass from all-applicable strict pass.
review.masking: Random six candidate labels; GPT sees actual per-answer history because it is required for judging. History treatment may be obvious; not fully blind. Freeze judgments before identity key. Identical full history and visible answer must receive identical judgments.

limits: Fixed authored correct histories include useful desired behavior and change wording/style/length together; not natural self-generated rollout or isolated causal attribution to one error. Same GPT authors fixtures/code and judges known repeated questions, single seed, same shared runtime; no independent human/holdout claim. Preserve historical reviews separately.
